name: pvp-events-site
description: Rankings, game history and player profiles for ranked Minecraft PvP events. Zero dependencies.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const walk=(d)=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((e)=>['node_modules','data'].includes(e.name)||e.name.startsWith('.')?[]:e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):/\.m?js$/.test(e.name)?[p.join(d,e.name)]:[]);const files=walk('.');for(const f of files)cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Syntax OK: '+files.length+' files');"
